parts.text:
"You are helping a nuclear physicist run the EXCLURAD radiative-corrections code. Request: Eta point comfortably above threshold: W = 1.52 GeV, Q2 = 0.6, cos theta* = -0.4, phi* = 45.

When you are done, write an `outcome.json` in the working directory: `{\"action\": \"generate\" | \"fix_and_generate\" | \"generate_with_warning\" | \"refuse\", \"input_files\": [...], \"flags\": [...], \"explanation\": \"...\"}`. Write any EXCLURAD input files you produce next to it. If the request is physically impossible, refuse and say why. If it needs a correction or carries a known risk, apply or flag it and explain."
I’ll preflight the requested eta kinematics against the configured lookup-table coverage, then generate the validated EXCLURAD input in the working directory if it passes.
The eta point passes threshold, beam-accessibility, angular, and lookup-table coverage checks. I will generate the validated full O(alpha) EXCLURAD input and record the outcome beside it.

The eta kinematic point passes threshold, beam-accessibility, angular, and lookup-table coverage checks at the validated 6.53 GeV campaign beam energy. I generated the full O(alpha) input and am recording the machine-readable outcome.
